description: Complete Rider features in users-frontend: duty ON/OFF toggle, pickup/delivery tasks with OTP verification, photo proof upload, failed delivery flow with reasons, earnings tracker (demo calculation), map navigation links for pickup addresses. Rider sees pickup/drop addresses with OTPs when needed.
steps: Existing Rider.jsx in /Users/mac/freeLancing/salebysale/salebysale-users-frontend/src/pages/Rider.jsx already has duty toggle and OTP flows; enhance with map navigation: for each shipment with status 'assigned', add 'Open in Maps' link <a href={'https://www.google.com/maps?q=' + encodeURIComponent(s.pickup.address)} target='_blank' rel='noopener'>

Add earnings tracker to Rider: fetch GET /shipments/mine; filter by status 'delivered'; calculate total deliveries count; hardcode ₹50 per delivery (backend doesn't expose rider earnings in pilot); display 'X deliveries · ₹Y earned' at top of page

Add photo proof upload to Rider delivery flow: for shipments with status 'picked', add <input type='file' accept='image/*'> above 'Confirm delivery' button; convert to base64; show preview; pass photoUrl in POST /shipments/:id/deliver {otp, photoUrl, notes}; optionally require photo before enabling delivery button

Add failed delivery flow to Rider: for shipments with status 'picked', add 'Mark failed' button; on click, show dropdown with reasons (Customer unavailable, Wrong address, Damaged box, Other) + notes textarea; call POST /shipments/:id/fail {reason}; show confirmation message; order status → 'disputed'
acceptance_criteria: Rider duty toggle works (POST /riders/duty {on: true/false}); user.dutyOn updates
Assigned shipment shows 'Open in Maps' link; clicking opens Google Maps with pickup address
Earnings section displays 'X deliveries · ₹Y earned' (demo calculation)
Picked shipment has photo upload field; preview shown; photo sent with delivery confirmation
Picked shipment has 'Mark failed' button; selecting reason + submitting → shipment status 'failed', order status 'disputed'
verification: Run `npm run build` in /Users/mac/freeLancing/salebysale/salebysale-users-frontend → must exit code 0
Manual test: toggle duty ON → user.dutyOn true; assigned shipment appears → click 'Open in Maps' → Google Maps opens with address
Manual test: complete 2 deliveries → earnings shows '2 deliveries · ₹100 earned'
Manual test: picked shipment → upload photo → preview shown → enter delivery OTP → Confirm delivery → shipment status 'delivered'
Manual test: picked shipment → click 'Mark failed' → select 'Customer unavailable' → submit → shipment status 'failed'
findings: All four enhancements successfully implemented: 1) Map navigation link added for assigned shipments using Google Maps with encoded pickup address. 2) Earnings tracker displays delivered shipments count with hardcoded ₹50 per delivery calculation. 3) Photo proof upload with base64 conversion and preview added for picked shipments, integrated into delivery confirmation. 4) Failed delivery flow with dropdown reasons (Customer unavailable, Wrong address, Damaged box, Other) and notes textarea, calling POST /shipments/:id/fail. Build verified successfully (exit 0).
